blocks.body:
Shrink and unshrink tools in record time while saving energy and protecting shrink fit holders: you get all these advantages with the »powerShrink« inductive shrink system. The »powerShrink« device series allows you to increase the efficiency of your production.

»actbyLight« guides you safely through the shrinking process and includes the »shrinkbyLight« coil function, LED control on the induction coil, and »coolbyLight« LED user guidance on the cooling system.

blocks.body:
With »powerShrink« from ZOLLER, you save time, reduce your electricity costs and protect your shrink tool holders thanks to the perfect interplay of electronics, software and mechanics and a sophisticated, reliable shrinking process.

30% energy savings

blocks.title: 30% energy saving
blocks.text:
With ZOLLER induction technology, you can heat your shrink fit tool holders optimally. For you, this means: evenly over the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This gives you shorter heating and cooling times, shorter cycle times, protects the tool holders and increases their service life.

A particular advantage of »powerShrink«, with which ZOLLER is making its contribution to sustainable use in production, is the energy saving of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We are particularly proud of this. The heat and energy is used exactly where you need it to shrink your tools in and out safely.

blocks.header:
Shrink technology

Smart design for maximum efficiency
blocks.body:
The ZOLLER induction coil is an intelligent, well thought-out highlight of the »powerShrink«. Two windings connected in parallel within the coil can be activated separately and controlled differently depending on the clamping diameter and length. This enables optimum energy input into the clamping area, accelerates the heating and cooling process and protects your tool holders.

Coil with »varOct« shielding system Coil with shielding discs

blocks.title: When art hits the mark
blocks.text:
Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER's Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrinking process.

8 ferrite elements

Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly designed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding slide past each other in a closed loop - a design experience. The ZOLLER uniqueness for unbeatable design and efficiency.

blocks.title: Flexibility in the blink of an eye
blocks.text:
With the ZOLLER induction coil with shielding disks, you are opting for a simple, manual shrinking process for infrequent diameter changes or low variance.

Discs with different diameters ensure that the coil's magnetic field is optimally aligned and shields it accordingly. The optional »shrinkbyLight« operator guidance system, consisting of the control LED for diameter monitoring and the status display for the coils, also increases process reliability when operating your »powerShrink«.

blocks.body:
With »powerShrink« from ZOLLER, you can cool with maximum efficiency. The five cooling bells for standard-compliant shrink fit tool holders from D6 mm to D32 mm ensure fast, even cooling thanks to their intelligent design and integrated contact cooling. Your shrink fit tool holders are protected and the high concentricity is maintained.

Cooling bells Cooling bell guide ZOLLER »zStream«

blocks.title: Focused on comfort and safety
blocks.text: The right cooling bell for every requirement: choose between the standard cooling bell or the cooling bell with »coolbyLight« operator guidance for maximum safety for your operators. Both cooling bells are available with free guidance or linear, mechanical guidance as required.

blocks.title: Cooling bell guide
blocks.text: Simply hooked in or securely guided? Choose between two variants of the cooling bell guide: the simple fixing mechanism or the linear guide for maximum comfort and safety.

blocks.title: The unique cooling alternative
blocks.text: With the »zStream« air cooling by ZOLLER you get maximal flexibility and protection with the cooling of your tools and shrink fit tool holder, independently of their contour or diameter. Tool cutting edges are in absolutely no danger of being damaged. You require absolutely no accessories such as a cooling adapter. In addition, your shrink tools are cooled evenly along their entire length.
